name: Do contractors handle debris haul-away and disposal after cabinet removal?

mainEntity.name: Do contractors handle debris haul-away and disposal after cabinet removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, old cabinetry, countertops, and drywall debris are hauled away as part of our comprehensive remodeling service. Proper disposal or recycling is organized so your driveway, garage, and home stay clean throughout the project. If you plan to salvage certain pieces for garage storage, a workshop, or donation, let our crew know during the initial walk-through so we can stage and protect those items on-site instead of loading them onto the disposal truck.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, full-service removal includes hauling away all cabinetry, counters, and related debris, unless you choose to set pieces aside for salvage.
